import boto3

def stream_microphone():
    client = boto3.client('transcribe')
    stream = client.start_stream_transcription(
        LanguageCode='en-US',
        MediaEncoding='pcm',
        MediaSampleRate=16000,
        StreamURL='https://your-stream-url'
    )
    yield from stream['TranscriptResultStream']

import boto3

def stream_chunks():
    client = boto3.client('transcribe')
    stream = client.start_stream_transcription(
        LanguageCode='en-US',
        MediaEncoding='pcm',
        MediaSampleRate=16000,
        StreamURL='https://your-stream-url'
    )
    yield from stream['TranscriptResultStream']

import boto3

def partial_results():
    client = boto3.client('transcribe')
    stream = client.start_stream_transcription(
        LanguageCode='en-US',
        MediaEncoding='pcm',
        MediaSampleRate=16000,
        StreamURL='https://your-stream-url'
    )
    yield from stream['TranscriptResultStream']

import boto3

def stream_with_language(language_code='en-US'):
    client = boto3.client('transcribe')
    stream = client.start_stream_transcription(
        LanguageCode=language_code,
        MediaEncoding='pcm',
        MediaSampleRate=16000,
        StreamURL='https://your-stream-url'
    )
    yield from stream['TranscriptResultStream']

import boto3

def translate_caption(caption, target_language):
    client = boto3.client('translate')
    result = client.translate_text(Text=caption, SourceLanguageCode='en', TargetLanguageCode=target_language)
    return result['TranslatedText']

import boto3

def check_safety(text):
    client = boto3.client('comprehend')
    result = client.detect_sentiment(Text=text, LanguageCode='en')
    return result['Sentiment']

import boto3

def summarize_meeting(transcript):
    client = boto3.client('comprehend')
    result = client.start_summarization_job(
        InputDataConfig={'S3Uri': 's3://your-bucket/input/'},
        OutputDataConfig={'S3Uri': 's3://your-bucket/output/'},
        LanguageCode='en',
        SummarizationType='meeting'
    )
    return result['JobId']

import boto3

def embed_caption(caption):
    client = boto3.client('comprehend')
    result = client.detect_dominant_language(Text=caption)
    return result['Languages'][0]['LanguageCode']
